Hallen Museum of Design
3 October to 24 January
Forty two pictures of weather, taken from the same bench over seven years.
Bring a towel. Swimming trunks required in mixed sessions. 90 kr, or ten visits for 700.
Most of them birch, a few hundred oak along the south fence. Survival after the first winter was 91 percent, up from 78.

Planting days begin on the first Saturday of April.
Bring boots. We bring coffee.
Book club meets on the 19th, seven o'clock, at the corner library. We are reading something short.
